item.title: Anime Expo 2025 Draws Near!
item.description: Anime Expo 2025 kicks off Thursday, July 3! Review the details on our booth activities, stamp rally, giveaways, and panel hosted by Producer and Director, Naoki Yoshida which will be streamed live for adventures around the globe to tune into. Read on for details.

item.title: New Optional Items Available!
item.description: New optional items will be added to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store starting Monday, June 30 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store. * The items featured above will be available for purchase after the scheduled maintenance ends on Monday, June 30 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). Please visit the News section for detailed maintenance information. * During periods immediately following the sale of new optional items, congestion in the delivery system may cause item deliveries to take longer than usual.

item.description: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY XIV Edition is available for 20% off! Furthermore, a 30-day free trial is available for adventurers who wish to experience the enhanced audio immersion before making a purchase. For those who have previously enjoyed the trial, a second 14-day free trial is available. Don’t miss this chance to bring a whole new dimension of sound to your adventures!

item.title: Watch the Latest Episode of Duty Commenced!
item.description: The latest episode of the North American Community team's Duty Commenced live show has been archived and is now available to view! Couldn't join the team live this time? No problem! The episode is available to watch below or on the official FINAL FANTASY XIV Twitch channel. This episode, the Community team reviewed exciting details coming in Patch 7.3 from the latest Letter from the Producer LIVE!

Join us in Japan for THE PRIMALS Dark Decades Tour BUDOKAN!
item.description: THE PRIMALS will be performing at Nippon Budokan in Tokyo on Monday, September 29 and Tuesday, September 30! For this performance, there will be an advance ticket drawing for FFXIV players in North America and Europe. If you are interested, we encourage you to apply! Read on for details.

The Unending Journey – Live Stream Adventures with the Community Team
item.description: Get ready for The Unending Journey's next episode on Friday, June 27! Join the EU Community team as we tackle some brand-new challenges! For this episode, we'll be doing a recap of the Letter from the Producer LIVE Part LXXXVII before heading to the Occult Crescent for a grand expedition! Put on your best glamour and join us for some screenshots at the Tuliyollal Aetheryte Plaza on Ragnarok (Chaos DC)!

item.title: Celebrating Heavenward's 10th Anniversary with a Sweepstakes!
item.description: It has been a decade since our Warriors of Light first cast their gazes Heavensward, and to commemorate the occasion, we'll be hosting a sweepstakes! Enter for a chance to win a silver pendant styled in memory of a dear comrade, as a reminder that even though a shield may break, the bonds of friendship can never be broken. Read on for details.

item.title: Join us for Duty Commenced on June 25!
item.description: The next episode of Duty Commenced, the North American Community team's live show, is set for Wednesday, June 25. Join the Community team while they recap exciting information on Patch 7.3 from the latest Letter from the Producer LIVE. As always, there will be a showcase of the latest entries for Community Commendations and giveaways! Read on for details.

item.title: [Gaia] Recovery from Instanced Areas Technical Difficulties (Jun. 22)
Announcing FINAL FANTASY XIV: Chronicles of Light, Volume II
item.description: We are delighted to announce that FINAL FANTASY XIV: Chronicles of Light, Volume II is due for release on Tuesday, October 7, with pre-orders available from today! This collection contains a total of thirty short stories, including those originally published on the Lodestone as Tales from the Shadows, Tales from the Twilight, Tales from the Dawn, and Tales under the New Moon, along with four new and exclusive stories. The book features cover art and illustrations by acclaimed FINAL FANTASY artist Toshiyuki Itahana.

item.title: Join Us at Anime Expo 2025!
item.description: FINAL FANTASY XIV is headed to Los Angeles for Anime Expo 2025! We invite new and seasoned adventurers to join us on the show floor to experience our stamp rally activity, create their own Warriors of Light through the New Player Experience, and create memories at our photo spot. Producer & Director Naoki Yoshida will also be attending as a Guest of Honor and will be featured on a panel discussing his career, inspirations, and Japanese pop culture. Read on for details.

item.title: A Seneschal Function for All!
item.description:
Greetings everyone, this is Sicycre from the Community team! 
The flowery season of spring is just around the corner, and we're about to see some cherry blossoms in Eorzea as well. That's right! Our next seasonal event is Little Ladies' Day!

item.title: A Bouquet's the Way for Valentione's Day
item.description:
Lali-ho! This is Kiwikopo from the Community team~ o/
Hope you've all been staying warm (unless, of course, you're a Warrior of Light from the southern hemisphere) and that it hasn't been too chilly. The temperature here is pretty frosty and hasn't been particularly kind to my fingertips, so I'm typing this while enjoying a hearty cuppa - a guaranteed way to warm both your fingers and heart!

item.title: Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood Recap! (Dec. 2024)
item.description:
Greetings everyone, this is Voltenyne from the Community team! 
I'm back with the latest recap of Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood, the housing tour series presented by Global Community Producer Toshio "Foxclon" Murouchi! The broadcast series aims to bring attention to the wonderful housing designs created by our player community, so we hope you'll come take a look at what your fellow housing enthusiasts have been up to!

item.title: All You Gotta Do Is Just Meet Me at PAX Aus 2024
item.description:
Lali-ho! Kiwikopo here, reporting in with stories from the team's adventures in the wonderful land of Oz--I mean Australia--this year.
We attended both Melbourne International Games Week and PAX Australia in early October, and for the first time in a decade, a few members of the Development team also flew over from Japan to join us in celebrating FFXIV in the land Down Under.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Littlejem
item.description:
Scree-tings, one and all! This is the Community team reporting in with our next Community Spotlight~
Any Warriors of Light out there who attended the Fan Festival 2023 in London or tuned in online will surely remember Yoshi-P's iconic entrance onto the stage dressed in a viper costume.

item.title: You Think I'm Going to Fall for an Illusion?!
item.description:
Hello everyone, this is Pumpkin Spicycre from the Community team!
The fall weather really swooped in once we neared October! Seems like just several days ago, we were still wearing summer clothing and complaining about the heat; that's all gone as if it were simply an illusion!

item.title: Gamescom 2024 & Cologne Fan Celebration Recap
item.description:
Hello, everyone!
This is Vystenya, Chesskyth, and Alevercey from the EU Community team, back with a special recap for gamescom 2024.

item.title: Journey (PAX) West, unto Tural!
item.description:
Hello, everyone! 
Ali here from the FFXIV Marketing team! I'm so excited to be back with another recap, this time for PAX West 2024! As we journeyed west to Tural, so too did we journey west to Seattle, Washington to bring exciting activities to our Warriors of Light! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Francis from the Marketing team and Minaryne from the Community team who will help me paint the picture of PAX West as beautifully as any pictomancer...

item.title: Community Spotlight: Hector Hectorson
item.description:
Greetings, Warriors of Light!
Have you ever stepped into extreme or savage duties in FINAL FANTASY XIV? If so, do you prefer progressing through the fight without any hints, or would you look to consult a guide?

item.title: An Anniversary Rising
item.description:
Ohokaliy! It's Kiwikopo from the Community team~ 
Have you been enjoying the Moonfire Faire? If you have yet to partake in the summery festivities, you'll have until Monday, August 26 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) to complete the event quest and receive the Uchiwasshoi emote. Don't forget to give the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course a go as well, I promise the view is worth it!

item.title: "Give it All" in the Arcadion!
item.description:
Hello, Warriors of Light!   I'm Francis from the Marketing team, and like many of you I have been enraptured by "Give it All," the song that plays during the battle against Wicked Thunder in the Arcadion. 
The song's vocals were performed by Chrissy Costanza, lead vocalist for the popular rock band Against the Current, who worked in close collaboration with Masayoshi Soken and THE PRIMALS. Chrissy was amazing to work with and her distinct rock vocals really turn up the energy and electrify the atmosphere during battle!

item.title: It's a Party: EU Fan Gathering Recap!
item.description:
Greetings! This is Vystenya, Chesskyth, and Kiwikopo from the EU Community team, reporting in from London HQ with a special blog on our latest Fan Gatherings in Europe!
It's been a while since we've hosted some get-togethers with our players, and with several major events happening this year, we thought it would be a great opportunity to put the wheels back in motion.
